_comment: Normalized (bare, lowercase) domains that must NEVER be used to group/merge orgs. These are shared hosts where two orgs sharing the domain are NOT the same company: generic mailbox providers, parked-page/registrar placeholders, link shorteners, and marketplace/portfolio domains. Keep entries as bare registrable domains (no scheme/www/path). Add to this list whenever a dry run surfaces a group of clearly-unrelated companies sharing one of these.
